statement: 0x47 consumer discrepancy, SDL side: Triton code explicitly decodes report 0x47 with a 2-byte trackpad timestamp and 16-bit IMU timestamp, while Linux has no 0x47 dispatch. SDL:539-550 and packed header:653-677. Use source-backed 0x42 length54 for shared host support, not SDL-only 0x47 as the sole report.

applicability.scope: Host-consumer expectations differ; this is a source comparison, not a conflict between measured device captures. Common behavior and reconciliation are stated in claim.
